sources.title: Jason's stoic character in Grand Theft Auto 6 was inspired by Steve McQueen and research into Army veterans: 'These guys typically aren't running their mouths'
sources.text: Rockstar made a point of creating "authentic characters that didn't stray too far from reality." It's already clear that Grand Theft Auto 6 has a very different timbre than most other GTA games. While criminal hijinks and acerbic satire remain part of the experience, it's also much more interested in portraying characters and relationships in a more convincing, human fashion. One of the most striking examples of this is its depiction of co-protagonist Jason Duval, who, unlike the vast majority of GTA's main characters, is often notable for what he doesn't say rather than what he does. According to Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative Rupert Humphries, Jason's laconic nature was inspired by a personality type observed in both cinema and real-life. "When we decided we wanted to tell a story about a couple on the run, we looked at all the similar kinds of movies, and one of the ones that really stood out was [Sam] Peckinpah's The Getaway" Humphries explained in a statement given to Destructoid (via GamesRadar ). Steve McQueen was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone. We wanted to see how close we could get to that with a game character, where so many of our protagonists have been the opposite." Humphries says this also "resonated" with research the studio was doing around Army veterans, particularly Army Rangers. In Grand Theft Auto 6 , Duval is a veteran of the game's equivalent military organisation called the Marauders. "These guys typically aren't running their mouths or reacting to something unless it's strictly necessary, while still being strong and still asserting themselves," Humphries explained. Establishing a more grounded character was not solely a directive for Jason. It was a goal of the writing more broadly. This is interesting considering Florida was picked as the setting for GTA 6 in-part due to the wild 'Florida Man' stories that circulate on the Internet from the state. "Researching the prolific and headline-grabbing criminal activity that had been taking place over decades in Florida was an obvious starting point," game writer Michael Wiafe pointed out. "From then on, it was about coming up with authentic characters that didn't stray too far from reality but also were not totally bound by it either," Wiafe continues. "The majority of our main characters are undeniably reprehensible on paper, full-blown criminals, but also decent human beings. Their moral makeup isn’t necessarily cut-and-dry, and we don’t attempt to make excuses for them. What's important is how they resonate, no matter where you're experiencing the game in the world." This is just one of the things that makes Rockstar's latest crime sim a marvel on pretty much all fronts . And while us PC gamers will have to wait an unspecified amount of time before it arrives on the platform, you can bet it going to be quite the experience when it does. sources.text: Sex work is depicted in one form or another in most Grand Theft Auto games, and though you canât hire prostitutes this time around , you can definitely still go to a strip club and see a show in Grand Theft Auto 6 . So where are these fine establishments, and what can you actually do there? Letâs break it down. There are three strip clubs in GTA 6 , and you actually wonât have to go looking for them because the main story will bring you to all of them. Thereâs Delights Cabaret, NINE1NINE, and Jack of Hearts. The first one is in Port Gellhorn where youâll spend the majority of the gameâs second chapter, and the other two are in Vice City proper.Â You can visit any of these locations as either Jason or Lucia, and both can participate in their services. You can shake it on the dancefloor and make it rain on the performers if you have cash on-hand. However, if you want something a little more private, you can hire performers for a private dance by holding down the left trigger to interact with them and paying their fee. Jason and Lucia can do this together or separately, though it will cost more for both of them to join in on the fun than it is for a solo show, and doing so doesnât seem to have any negative bearing on their relationshipÂ At the moment, Iâve been able to confirm that Lucia is able to get a lap dance from female dancers, but I havenât seen any evidence that Jason can receive them from men. Thus far, the only male dancers Iâve found in the game were those who perform during the âAfternoon Delightâ mission, which features them prevalently and lets the player get a first-person lap dance from a male dancer. However, it doesnât appear that you can seek them out whenever you want like you can the women. My gut reaction is to assume that this is so players canât make Jason do gay stuff, and thatâs a huge bummer for a game that seems to be pretty open-minded and is obviously willing to let Lucia engage in some same-sex services. Jason and Lucia seem more than willing to enjoy sexy entertainment together, and can have plenty of sex at home if youâre nurturing their relationship.Â Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. sources.title: GTA 6 hacker who leaked footage in 2022 has been released on licence and told not to do it again
sources.text: Arion Kurtaj was deemed to fit to stand trial earlier this year The UK teenager who hacked Rockstar and leaked footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 has been released on licence and warned not to do anything like it again. In 2022, Arion Kurtaj, who suffers from acute autism, was convicted of being a member of the international hacking group Lapsus$, which also carried out attacks on tech companies including Uber, Nvidia and EE. In late 2023, a judge determined that Kurtaj â who was 18 at the time â remained fixated with hacking and posed “a high risk of serious harm to the public through skill in gaining unfettered access to computers”. It was decided that Kurtaj would stay at a secure hospital facility until such time that a mental health tribunal decided he no longer posed a danger to others. Earlier this year, however, it was decided that he was now fit to stand trial, and was released to a normal prison in January. The trial took place last week, where Kurtaj pleaded guilty. Now, as reported by the BBC , he has been given a Serious Crime Prevention Order, which restricts his online activity for the next five years, including a ban on using Telegram and Discord. According to the report, the judge told Kurtaj that he was “a very talented young man”, and told him: “Don’t let this happen again.” In September 2022, Kurtaj and other hackers published an hour of GTA 6 development footage online , giving players their first look at the sequel to one of the best-selling games of all-time. This footage included the first look at Lucia, confirming for the first time that the game would feature a female protagonist. At the time, Rockstar said it was “extremely disappointed” to have details on the game shared in this way, and proceeded to release the game’s first trailer later that year, officially confirming the female lead.

sources.title: The Grand Theft Auto 6 hacker who was hospitalized in 2023 has been released on parole with a warning not to do it again
sources.text: Following his guilty plea, Arion Kurtaj was given a seven-year sentence but released "on license" with a warning and restrictions to his online activity.. A BBC report says Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who was given an indefinite sentence in hospital in 2023 because he kept hacking into things or expressing intent to, has been released with a stern warning not to do it again. Kurtaj was sentenced to seven years in prison, according to the report, but was released on license—similar to parole in North America—the same day, with his hospital stay and time in prison while awaiting retrial credited as time served. He was given a five-year "Serious Crime Prevention Order" restricting his allowable online activity, including bans on using Telegram and Discord. "Kurtaj knew what he was doing when he carried out these crimes and has finally admitted his involvement," Detective Inspector Mike O'Sullivan of the City of London Police said following Kurtaj's sentencing and release. "We hope this case serves as a lesson that these types of acts will not be tolerated. "Although cyber crime is borderless, we will seek to utilise the co-operation of partner agencies and international law enforcement to ensure that offenders are brought to justice no matter where they offend from." Kurtaj carried out hacks against multiple companies when he was 16 and 17 years old, including Microsoft , Samsung , Nvidia and UK telecom company BT&EE, and stole millions in cryptocurrency from individuals. But it was his hack of Rockstar and leak of GTA 6 materials more than a year before it was formally revealed, that earned him notoriety, not least because of how it was carried out: While under police protection in a Travelodge hotel room , using an Amazon Fire Stick and a mobile phone. A psychiatric assessment determined that Kurtaj had "acute autism," and that he "continued to express the intent to return to cybercrime as soon as possible" while he was in custody. That led to his hospital sentence , but earlier this year he was found fit to stand trial and subsequently pleaded guilty to all charges . That struck me as odd—why plead guilty to crimes carried out at a time when your mental state was such that a court decided you required multiple years of institutionalization?—but this may be the answer: Kurtaj, now 21, is a free man. The judge on the case told Kurtaj he is "a very talented young man," but also warned him: "Don't let this happen again." sources.title: YouTuber Discovers Wild GTA 6 Easter Egg, Cracks Code in Just 3 Days to Reveal Brilliant Surprise
sources.text: A YouTuber has uncovered the wildest GTA 6 Easter egg yet. Following a series of arcane clues and pulling a set of switches in the correct order sees players transported back to the 1980s. The Easter egg begins in the R&D tower in Key Lento, GTA 6’s starting area, but spans almost the entire map. Players have to pull a series of switches and press certain buttons to trigger a portal into the past, complete with new voice acting from Danny Dyer as Kent Paul. After scaling the tower, the YouTuber ( Memeio ) noticed that a sound effect from GTA Vice City plays when he messed with the lever and button. A poster for LPL (Leonida Power and Light) in the room then guided him around Leonida to the LPL power substations dotted around the map. Each substation contained letters written on its walls. Memeio was so committed to figuring out the mystery that he actually followed the power cables across the map to track them all down. After putting all the letters together from all 12 substations, Memeio realized they spelled out an interesting phrase: “Life is passing me by.” That phrase was a cheat code in Vice City that sped up the in-game clock. On PlayStation, the code for that cheat was: Circle, L1, Square, L1, Square, L1, Triangle, Circle, Triangle. Memeio realized that he had to enter that code using all the buttons and switches at the various substations, applying a button to different lever flips and button presses. After pressing the buttons in order, without fast travelling, Memeio got an in-game text to head to Reactor 2 between 7pm and 6am. When he did, a portal opened. Stepping through the portal transported him to Vice City’s Malibu Club, complete with polygonal graphics. Upstairs, he even saw Kent Paul, voiced by British actor Danny Dyer, reprising his role. Danny Dyer is included in the credits for GTA 6 under the “local population" category. For all that effort, you get access to Tommy Vercetti’s iconic floral shirt and his classic Malibu bike, complete with star decals. As requested, here is the entire cutscene! I highly recommend you go and do this secret yourself, but I'm happy to share it with the world (I literally spent three days following powerlines in game to find the substations...) 🤓 https://t.co/3NuYYRqlCp Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? sources.title: GTA 6 Includes A Mario And Luigi Easter Egg
sources.text: Easter Egg Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Mario You are likely aware that Rockstar’s recently released Grand Theft Auto 6 is a big game. But what you might not understand is just how much of this massive open world is filled with secrets, Easter eggs, and other oddities just waiting to be discovered. This includes a well-hidden block that you can break to reveal two hats that look a lot like what Mario and Luigi might wear. As discovered and shared by Twitter user xGarbett, if you head to Lummox County, the region of GTA 6 located north of Vice City, and start exploring the woods in the southwest portion of Moreau, you’ll be able to find the dilapidated brick and stone ruins of a long-destroyed building. Explore these ruins, and near the top of them is a partially invisible block floating in the air above one of the tallest bits of the out-of-the-way ruin. Jump into that block, just like a famous plumber might do in a Nintendo game, and out will pop two hats for Jason and Lucia. XGarbett shows the precise location in the video below: Head to this location in GTA 6 to unlock a secret Super Mario Easter Egg. Breaking the block like Mario will drop Mario & Luigi style hats for Jason & Lucia. pic.twitter.com/H2CJmdpNod I went there on my own to see if this was all accurate, and yes, I can confirm that this works. I didn’t see the box at first, but after I got up there just like xGarbett did, the hidden cube became visible. However, try as I might, I could not get Jason to break the block by jumping into it. Instead, I just pulled out my gun and shot it, and the hats popped out. I imagine Mario would love to have an SMG on him for times like this. Anyway, I grabbed both, called Lucia, and headed to a clothing shop where we got dressed up in the sunlight with our new, legally distinct hats. GTA 6 appears to be filled with secrets and little Easter eggs like this. For example, if you’re wondering how I got the shirt you see Jason wearing in the screenshot I shared above which was once worn by Tommy Vercetti, you might want to read this post about the wildest hidden secret people have found in GTA 6 so far: The ability to travel back in time to Vice City on the PS2. sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

stories.summary: Plus you can experience it all from the comfort of your campervan.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: This '90s-inspired horror game has one of the coolest post-apocalyptic worlds I've ever seen
sources.text: Plus you can experience it all from the comfort of your campervan. I often find myself thinking where the best place to survive a zombie apocalypse would be. A walled-off stone house would certainly make for some good defenses, a boat would be great—but only if the zombies didn't pull a Fear the Walking Dead—or you could spend the end of the world in a camper van. That would certainly be whimsical. You do just this in The Road of Dust and Sorrow's demo , although it's certainly not as whimsical as I first imagined it to be. You see, in this 2D horror game you have bigger responsibilities than just keeping yourself alive, you also have a young daughter to look out for as well. This isn't an easy task. Supplies are dwindling, zombie-like humans infected by addictive chemicals amble across the land in search of more dust, but they'll settle for your blood instead. Plus there's this creepy Pastor who's definitely up to something very bad. I only got one glimpse of him in the demo and he was surrounded by a lot of gore and eldritch horror, so I've just decided that staying away from him is probably for the best. But you can't hunker down and forget about all these terrors, because you have a daughter to feed and protect. So I spent most of my time in the demo gathering food, medical supplies, and trying to locate an item that may just grant us safe passage to the only sanctuary humanity has left. The dev, Painted Black Games, says it took inspiration from horror series like Silent Hill and Resident Evil for The Road of Dust and Sorrow, and while I haven't come across anything particularly traumatic in a Silent Hill sense yet (although I wouldn't be surprised to see that here) I can see the through line to Resident Evil. The action is smooth, accurate, and rewarding—which surprised me as I usually don't vibe with 2D gunplay, sometimes the controls are too finicky, but it certainly works here. Head-shotting the zombies is incredibly satisfying, as is kicking them to the floor and beating them with a baseball bat. Then there are the puzzles. I didn't come across too many, but the ones I did find were very rewarding. It's not rocket science, but the solutions aren't always obvious either. They are, however, very intuitive; you can do a lot with a little, something I very much appreciate. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. But my favourite aspect of The Road of Dust and Sorrow has to be just how cool this post-apocalyptic world is. Maybe it's the pixel art, but it manages to look dilapidated and creepy while also being oddly pretty to look at. I was searching an abandoned warehouse full of zombies and rotting cargo while thinking to myself that with a bit of elbow grease this place could really scrub up. If you want pretty and cosy, though, the campervan is where it's at. I didn't spend as much time as I would have liked to there, but it managed to feel like a real home—the only safe place left in this world. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Elie is a news writer with an unhealthy love of horror games—even though their greatest fear is being chased. When they're not screaming or hiding, there's a good chance you'll find them testing their metal in metroidvanias or just admiring their Pokemon TCG collection. sources.title: ‘It was the coolest thing I’d ever seen’: The story of Rez, 25 years on
sources.text: On its 25th anniversary, the developers behind Segaâs cult classic tell its story – and reveal why its sequel was cancelled Itâs August 2024. I’m riding through the neon-soaked streets of Tokyoâs Shibuya Ward in a Porsche, with the director of one of my favorite games at the wheel. We’re heading to his home, where he’s promised to show me beta builds that have never been seen before, and details on its canned sequel. There’s no shortage of hard work involved in covering video games, but every so often you have one of those days that makes you stop and think: wow, I’m lucky to do this. This was one of them. For me, Rez was a revelatory experience that arrived during a formative moment in my life. I was about to turn 16, leave school, and enter a hedonistic life of clubbing, music, and the human connection that comes with it. At the same time, my gaming habits had broadened into a more eclectic mix of multiplatform games, with publications like Edge encouraging me to think more about them as an artistic medium. It was inevitable, then, that I’d eventually take a chance on an electric arthouse shooter from the arcade masters at Sega . I went in blind, and discovering its abstract wireframes and interactive techno beats for myself was a deeply affecting experience. It was like simultaneously conducting a Chemical Brothers album and the Ministry of Sound light show, behind the controls of a Space Harrier machine, in a combo only video games could power. To view Rez as simply a shooter is to completely miss its meaning. On the surface, it shares much with on-rails arcade games like Panzer Dragoon and Star Fox , tasking players with blasting their way through waves of enemies on route to a spectacular boss. But these familiar mechanics are a vehicle for something more transcendent. UGAâs young team were trying to do something few commercially developed games had attempted before. Rezâs central concept is synaesthesia, the phenomenon of one sensory experience triggering another, like sounds provoking certain shapes and colors. The player is treated as a participant in a performance, with the gameâs licensed music responding to every dispatched enemy with a hi-hat or synthesizer, like you’re some sort of Tron-age conductor. All the while, its pulsing, Kandinsky-inspired visuals move in harmony with the audio, and your game controller passes the vibrations through your body, as if youâve plugged the Dreamcast into your own auxiliary port. There was simply nothing else like Rez at the time. It isn’t hyperbole to say that United Game Artists’ extraordinary sensory alchemy fundamentally changed how I, and many others of a similar age, viewed video games and what they could be. Its sales werenât spectacular, but Rezâs cultural impact makes it as valuable as any blockbuster. “It isn’t hyperbole to say that United Game Artists’ extraordinary sensory alchemy fundamentally changed how I, and many others of a similar age, viewed video games and what they could be.” Rez mattered because it showed, at a time when creators were obsessed with emulating Hollywood, that video games could create experiences that other entertainment mediums couldnât replicate. With its Y2K-inspired aesthetic, arcade-coded design, and deep reverence for late 90s club culture, Rez is staunchly a creation of its time, but itâs also absolutely timeless. To this day, Iâll regularly throw some headphones on, or a VR headset, and blast through Area 3, with its thumping Ken Ishii techno, or if Iâm in a more energetic mood, the evolutionary rollercoaster of Adam Freelandâs finale, and go beyond synaesthesia. âI do think as time has marched on, the game has become more celebrated and dear to people than when it was originally released,â producer Tetsuya Mizuguchi tells me in a meeting room at his latest studio, Enhance (he wasnât the one driving the car, by the way â weâll get to that later). âWhen we were making it too, towards the end of development, it felt more like the start of something than the end of a project for me personally, but I didn’t really know what it was the start of. I think in many ways, because it was this primitive experience, because it didn’t fit exactly into one genre convention, perhaps one of the reasons it took some time for the adulation to come to the fore has a lot to do with it took people some time to find the words that allowed them to accurately describe what they liked about the experience.â It wasnât just the players who struggled to verbalize what that Rez experience meant, Mizuguchi says. âLooking back at myself and the development team, we had trouble when we were making it, trying to express what the team was and what we were after. âBack then, we’d spend a lot of time doing things like going to electronic music clubs and observing the crowds there, and the kind of different types of reactions they’d have as music would change, and what would move them, and trying to kind of pick up clues from that sort of reaction and human experience that we were trying to then apply into Rez. âBecause we were young, because we were fairly inexperienced, we were really operating a lot more off of intuition about what this game was going to become and how we were going to get there and what we were borrowing from these sort of observed human experiences. And so, in that sense, not just for the players, but for ourselves, it’s kind of taken these 25 years to better define what we were trying to go after and what made it special.â Mizuguchi describes the circumstances surrounding Rez’s development as something of a ‘perfect storm’, much of which was deliberately engineered. The genesis of Rez, or ‘K-Projekt’ as it was first known, required a moment of inspiration and an unconventional work environment. The embers of the idea came from a spontaneous road trip. sources.title: GTA 6 ganha primeira atualização no PS5 e Xbox! Veja o que muda
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI Apenas alguns dias após a grande estreia, GTA 6 já recebeu uma nova atualização no PS5 e Xbox Series X|S que corrige problemas no sistema de salvamento automático — além de outros erros relatados pelos jogadores. O patch, que já está disponível para download, tem cerca de 603 MB e leva o jogo para a versão 01.002.002. Entre as mudanças, a Rockstar também corrigiu falhas que impediam a perda do nível de procurado e o acionamento correto de algumas ligações telefônicas. A atualização ainda resolve problemas de travamento e outros erros que afetavam diferentes atividades do jogo. Desde o lançamento de GTA 6 , os jogadores têm relatado dificuldades com o sistema de salvamento automático. Em alguns casos, os problemas teriam resultado até na perda de dados, fazendo com que parte do progresso nas primeiras horas de jogo desaparecesse. Embora o título salve automaticamente após missões principais e algumas atividades secundárias, o recurso aparentemente não estava funcionando de maneira consistente. Inclusive, houve relatos de jogadores que concluíram missões importantes, mas não tiveram o progresso registrado corretamente. A Rockstar afirma que corrigiu o problema na atualização mais recente, que também resolve outras falhas relacionadas à progressão. Entre elas, estavam erros que impediam o acionamento de ligações importantes para avançar na história ou desbloquear conteúdos de missões. Além de instalar o patch, vale conferir se o salvamento automático está funcionando normalmente. Por precaução, também é recomendável pausar o jogo e salvar o progresso manualmente sempre que possível. Confira as notas completas da atualização: Embora tenha sofrido review bomb da comunidade recentemente, GTA 6 é sem sombra de dúvidas o maior jogo de todos os tempos — não apenas pela sua escala monumental, mas também pelo impacto cultural que vem causando desde seu período de pré-lançamento. Mesmo gigante de diferentes formas possíveis, o game tem uma reprodução bastante assertiva nos consoles . Para aqueles que desejam a cobiçada platina do jogo, saibam que GTA 6 possui uma lista com mais de 50 troféus/conquistas para desbloquear . Além de um mapa interativo que pode te ajudar muito na jogatina, o título também conta com uma série de cheats e trapaças — mas que são ativáveis de forma diferente em comparação aos games anteriores da franquia. E você, já está jogando GTA 6 ? Conte nas redes sociais do VOXL se também enfrentou problemas com o salvamento automático do jogo! O que considerar na hora de comprar uma caixa de som potente?

sources.title: GTA 6 Motion Capture Actor Has No Idea Who He Is in the Game, Sparks Social Media Hunt to Find His Character
sources.text: One GTA 6 actor has no idea who he plays and has asked for fans to help him find his character in the game. Guy A. Fortt, who has previously played a guard in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos, did some performance capture work on GTA 6, but the secrecy of the project meant he didn’t have much context for his scenes. Actors are often kept in the dark when playing a part in Rockstar games. When Roger Clark auditioned for Red Dead Redemption 2 , for example, the only clue he had at the time was he was told to wear cowboy boots. That secrecy, combined with the time between performance and the game’s release, hasn’t helped in Fortt’s case. “So, I was a motion capture actor on GTA 6, but I don’t know who the hell I am,” Fortt explained in a video that went viral on Instagram . “I auditioned about four or five years ago, they put the balls all over my body and face … and then I forgot all about it.” “Then I get a random email telling me that I’m in GTA 6. This is where I need your help.” Fortt, who is 63 years old and doesn't have a PS5 or play video games himself, is looking for help tracking the character down. According to the actor, his performance saw him standing behind a counter of some kind, and he interacted with Jason and Lucia at one point. He could be some kind of store clerk, a receptionist, or even a cop at a desk, judging by his description. It would be very funny if he ended up being a guard again, like in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos. The community is currently on the hunt for his character, but it might take a while. Rockstar put lots of work into making GTA 6 NPCs varied , hiring dozens and dozens of actors to breathe life into the citizens of Leonida. In a follow-up social media post on day two of the hunt, Fortt said 3 million people were looking for his character in the game, but no luck yet. I assume that's based on social media impressions to his various posts on this, rather than people actively looking for his character in the game. But still, he's caught quite a bit of attention for this. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map . Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. sources.title: Who Plays Mandy in GTA 6?
sources.text: Since the release of GTA 6,Â Mandy has become a popular side character among fans. First appearing in the Pipework mission, fans have wondered who plays Mandy in GTA 6 since she first appeared in the game. In this guide, we’ll tell you who plays Mandy in GTA 6, where she appears in the game, and more. If you’re looking for GTA 6 guides, then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . We’re halfway through our complete walkthrough for the game, and also have guides on so much more. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. She confirmed her involvement in the highly anticipated game through a post on Instagram , revealing that she performed both the voice acting and motion capture for the character. Lexie Shoaibi has previously appeared in Hamster & Gretel, Atom and Hollywood. Grand Theft Auto 6 is her first credited video game performance. Mandy is a side character who players encounter during a very early mission in GTA 6’s story. She becomes involved in Jason storyline when he visits her property to collect overdue rent for Brian and help fix a blocked sink. However, as Jason fixes the sink, it becomes clear that Mandy is interested in far more than some DIY. This has caused many GTA 6 players to wonder if Jason can romance Mandy as part of GTA 6. Despite her best efforts, no matter how long Jason stays in Mandyâs house, there is no way to romance Mandy. All you can do with Mandy is ask her for the Plunger when you get into her room, and rebuff her advances. Eventually, sheâll demand that you leave her house. While you can still speak to Mandy, she will be upset with Jason, and eventually her reponses will repeat. Soon after this you’ll recieve text messages from her, but from here she dissappears from GTA 6.
